description.zh: 连接 Legado，提供阅读上下文、人物回顾和由 AI 主动维护的伴读记忆，通过生成任务维护章节摘要与段评。
description.en: Connects to Legado with reading context, character recall, proactively maintained AI companion memory, and tasks for chapter summaries and comments.

description.zh: 读取当前进度、回顾已读剧情、按用户明确操作生成摘要、查询人物并保存读者笔记或预测。
description.en: Reads current progress, recalls read plot, generates summaries only after explicit user actions, finds characters, and stores reader notes or predictions.

description.zh: 为每本书选择角色卡，多轮子代理读取目标章，按需查前情，生成少而精的角色化段评。模型依次采用发起对话的模型、角色卡固定模型或全局 CHAT 模型；记录展示实际使用的模型。Legado 将角色卡名字显示为作者。开启会产生模型 Token 消耗。
description.en: Selects a per-book character card and reads the target chapter, consulting earlier context only as needed. Uses the initiating conversation model, then the card's fixed model, then global CHAT; records show the model actually used. Legado displays the card name as author. Enabling spends model tokens.

description.zh: 启动、查询和取消摘要或段评生成任务。
description.en: Start, inspect, and cancel summary or commentary generation tasks.

description.zh: 浏览伴读文件、配置摘要范围、查看段评和审计记录。
description.en: Browse reading files, configure summary ranges, and inspect commentary and audit history.
